name: Command & Conquer
what: Classic real-time war strategy: build a base, gather resources, and command an army.

fanProjects.name: OpenRA
fanProjects.what: Fans rebuilt classic Command & Conquer and Red Alert with modern controls and online play. It downloads the free versions of the old game files for you.
howToPlay: Pick Red Alert or Tiberian Dawn, and let it get the free game files.

fanProjects.name: GeneralsGameCode
fanProjects.what: Fans build C&C Generals and Zero Hour from EA's released code, with fixes for today's computers.
howToPlay: Own C&C Generals and Zero Hour (in the Ultimate Collection).
Download the latest weekly build from its GitHub page and follow the README.

lovedFeatures: Gather resources and build a base
Train units and command them in real time
Different sides with their own units
